info.title: Find.ly API
info.description:
Search leak and OSINT data from your own code with the same modules, quota and limits as the Find.ly dashboard. API access comes with the Professional and Enterprise plans.

Find.ly serves its own modules. Most are powered by our search provider, Intelligence X — `intelligence-search`, `phonebook`, `identity-portal`, `system-id`, `storage-id` and the Stealer Export archive. `breach-search` is ours: it runs on a breach index Find.ly ingests and documents itself, on its own separate daily quota.

Every search is `POST /api/v1/search/{module}`. Each module has its own reference page below because each takes a different body.

post.description:
Downloads **every stealer log attached to one System ID**, packed into a single `.zip` archive.

Unlike every other endpoint, a success returns the **archive itself** (`application/zip`), not JSON. Errors still use the usual JSON envelope, so check the status code before reading the body.

**Professional and Enterprise only.** One request per export, whatever the archive holds. The request is given back when the service fails, times out, finds nothing, or returns an archive over 32 MB.

Archives are streamed straight through: Find.ly never stores their contents.

200.description: The archive (billed). Binary `.zip`; `Content-Disposition` carries the suggested file name.

403.description: `plan_required` (no API access) or `module_locked` (the plan does not include Stealer Export). Not billed.

404.description: `not_found` — no stealer logs are attached to this `system_id`. **The request is given back.**

422.description: `invalid_input` — `system_id` is missing or is not a UUID. See `error.fields`. Never billed.

429.description: `quota_exceeded` (daily quota), `rate_limited` (20 requests in the last minute, or an export already running on this account), or `too_many_requests` (60 API calls in a minute from this IP). Never billed.

502.description: `upstream_error` — the export service failed, timed out, or returned an archive over 32 MB. **The request is given back.**

post.description: Find one person's records across Find.ly's own breach index. Send a free-text `query`, an advanced `fields` object (ANDed), or both. Draws from a separate daily bucket (Starter 100, Professional 800, Enterprise 5000), not the request quota.

200.description: Search served (billed from the breach bucket), including a successful empty result.

XRequestBilled.description: `true` if this call used one request from the daily quota, otherwise `false`.

XQuotaLimit.description: Daily quota of the plan. Sent whenever the account quota is known (not on authentication or IP-limit errors).

XQuotaRemaining.description: Requests left today, after this call.

XQuotaReset.description: ISO 8601 time of the next reset (02:00 Europe/Paris).

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (at least 1).

ContentDisposition.description: `attachment; filename="…"`. The file name only contains `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`.

XResultsTruncated.description: `true` if the list was cut at 5,000 selectors.

XFileTruncated.description: `true` if the file is longer than what was delivered (8 MB cap).

XFileTotalBytes.description: Size of the whole file in bytes, or `unknown` when the file was too large to measure (over 16 MB).

Usage.description: Quota of the account, after the call.

plan_expires_at.description: End of the paid plan. `null` on Free.

daily_quota.description: Requests per day: 500 on Professional, 1,500 on Enterprise.

used.description: Requests used today, dashboard and API combined.

ErrorCode.description:
Stable, machine-readable error code:

- `api_key_in_url`: 400 — an API key was sent in the query string (`key`, `api_key`, `apikey`, `token` or `access_token`).
- `invalid_json`: 400 — the body is missing, is not valid UTF-8 JSON, or is not a JSON object.
- `unsupported_format`: 400 — `format` is not `json`, or `txt` was asked for a module that has no text output.
- `missing_api_key`: 401 — neither `Authorization` nor `X-API-Key` was sent.
- `invalid_api_key`: 401 — the key is malformed, unknown, regenerated, or belongs to a deleted account.
- `account_suspended`: 403 — the account that owns the key is suspended.
- `plan_required`: 403 — the account plan does not include API access (Professional and Enterprise only).
- `module_locked`: 403 — the account plan does not include this module (Stealer Export needs Professional or Enterprise).
- `unknown_module`: 404 — `{module}` is not a search module slug.
- `not_a_search_module`: 400 — `stealer-export` was called as a search module. Use `POST /api/v1/stealer-export`.
- `not_found`: 404 — no API endpoint at this path, or a Stealer Export whose System ID has no logs attached (the request is given back).
- `body_too_large`: 413 — the request body is over 16 KB.
- `invalid_input`: 422 — a field is unknown, has the wrong type, or has an invalid value. See `error.fields`.
- `too_many_requests`: 429 — more than 60 API calls in one minute from the same IP address.
- `quota_exceeded`: 429 — the account has used all of today's requests.
- `rate_limited`: 429 — two searches already running, an export already running, or 20 requests in the last minute, on this account.
- `internal_error`: 500 — unexpected server error. No request was used.
- `upstream_error`: 502 — the search or export service failed, timed out, or sent an unreadable or oversized response (an archive over 32 MB). The request is refunded.

message.description: Human-readable. It can change: branch on `code`, not on `message`.

fields.description: `invalid_input` only. One message per invalid or unknown field.

required_plan.description: `module_locked` only. Cheapest plan that includes the module.

reason.description: `rate_limited` only. Which account limit was hit.

upstream_status.description: `upstream_error` only. HTTP status returned by the search service when it sent one (400 or above), otherwise `null`.

username.description: Username of the account that owns the key.

modules.description: Module slugs open to this plan.

query.description: Email, username, domain or text to search for. Trimmed; 200 characters max.

max_results.description: Whole number from 1 to 1000, as a JSON number or a string of digits. Omit for the default.

media_type.description: Optional media type filter, passed as is. 200 characters max.

date_from.description: Start date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Must be a real calendar date.

type.description: What you want back: email addresses, domains (subdomains) or URLs. Case-insensitive.

query.description: Its shape depends on `type`: `@example.com` for `email`, `example.com` for `domain`, `https://example.com` for `url` (http or https, a real domain name, no credentials). Sent lowercased.
Email address, domain or other selector. Trimmed; 200 characters max.

system_id.description: UUID of the file, as returned in `results[].system_id`. Case-insensitive.

storage_id.description: 128 or 129 hexadecimal characters. Whitespace and line breaks are removed first; 1,000 characters max as sent.

name.description: Name of the source (up to 2,000 characters).

date.description: Normalized ISO 8601 date, or `null` if unreadable.

system_id.description: Lowercase UUID to download the raw file with System ID. `null` if missing or malformed.

selector.description: Email, domain or URL (up to 500 characters).

truncated.description: `true` if `text` is only the beginning of the file (8 MB cap).

total_bytes.description: Size of the whole file, or `null` if it was over 16 MB and could not be measured.

file.description: `null` when the file is empty or was not found.
`null` when the file is empty or was not found.

system_id.description: System ID of the record, as shown under Expert Information on intelx.io. A UUID: 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal characters.

BreachSearchRequest.description: Free-text `query`, advanced `fields`, or both — at least one is required. `query` searches every identity field at once; `fields` ANDs named fields to narrow to one person. IBAN and SIRET are never a search target.

query.description: Anything that names a person — email, full name, username, phone. Trimmed; 3–256 characters.

fields.description: Advanced search: each entry is a separate, required constraint (ANDed). 2–256 characters each, at most 10 fields. An unknown or sensitive key returns 422.

date.description: Breach date, as the index gives it.

breach_id.description: Key into `sources`. Empty string when the index did not name it.

record.description: Free object of field: value. Columns vary from one breach to the next. Never contains a password.

masked_fields.description: Keys in `record` returned partially (an IBAN as its last four characters).

query.description: The search as run: the free value, or the advanced fields joined.

total.description: Records found. Capped at 10,000 — see total_is_lower_bound.

total_is_lower_bound.description: `true` when the index stopped counting at 10,000.

truncated.description: `true` when total is greater than returned. There is no next page.

partial.description: `true` when the index ran out of time; an empty partial result is refunded.

sources.description: Map of breach_id to the breach it names.
